Package aor.proj3t.service.impl

Class TwoFactorAuthServiceImpl

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.service.impl.BaseService
aor.proj3t.service.impl.TwoFactorAuthServiceImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
TwoFactorAuthService
@ApplicationScoped public class TwoFactorAuthServiceImpl extends BaseService implements TwoFactorAuthService
Implementation of the TwoFactorAuthService interface. This service manages Two-Factor Authentication operations including TOTP setup, verification, backup codes, and 2FA management within the security framework.

Key functionalities include:

  • TOTP secret key generation and QR code URL creation for authenticator apps
  • Time-based one-time password verification with replay attack prevention
  • Backup code generation, verification, and one-time usage management
  • 2FA enablement/disablement with proper security validations
  • User 2FA status checking and management

This implementation follows RFC 6238 standards for TOTP and provides compatibility with popular authenticator applications like Google Authenticator, Authy, and Microsoft Authenticator.
